absent: Locking, reference counting ownership transfer, and sleep versus atomic context rules for node, property, changeset, notifier and overlay operations.
Behavior of the underlying helpers only named here such as string and variable array readers, phandle iterators, node finders, changeset dispatcher, address translation and IRQ parsing.
Meaning of numeric operation codes for changeset attach, detach, add, remove and update beyond their distinct roles.
Error code taxonomy and caller obligations for negative returns such as invalid argument, missing device, unsupported and not supported.
Device tree property value encoding, string list termination, cell endianness handling and address translation algorithm.
Lifetime and allocation rules for nodes, properties, changesets, parser objects and notifier blocks.

findings.text: String property helpers share one underlying string reader. Array read passes caller size with start zero, count passes null output with zero size, indexed read requests one element at caller index and normalizes non-negative results to success while preserving negative errors.

Presence testing treats a found property object as true and missing as false. System power controller testing checks one named boolean property. Populated tree testing checks root compatibility when device tree support is enabled and reports false otherwise.

Fixed width array readers for 8, 16, 32 and 64 bit values delegate to variable length counterparts with zero minimum and map any non-negative count to success. Scalar 8, 16 and 32 bit readers request a single element, and signed 32 bit scalar and indexed readers reuse the unsigned path with reinterpreted output.

Iteration helpers walk phandle lists with error driven termination, 32 bit property elements and strings via next element lookup, nodes by name, type, compatibility, match table or property, children in all, available, reserved and prefix filtered forms including scoped auto release variants, and CPU nodes in sequence.
Child counting helpers enumerate respectively all children and only available children and return the tally, starting from zero for a node with no enumerated children.

A changeset entry links into a list and carries a numeric action plus a node pointer and current and previous property pointers. A changeset itself is a container holding only the head of that entry list.

Changeset mutation moves through attach, detach, add, remove and update operations issued to one generic action dispatcher with distinct operation codes. A single 32 bit property convenience funnels into the array form with length one.
The disabled reconfig notification path uniformly reports invalid argument for register, unregister, notify and state change query, indicating notification is unavailable in this configuration.

Overlay notification progresses through initialization followed by pre apply, post apply, pre remove and post remove phases in that order, with initialization corresponding to zero filled allocation state.
Overlay notification data pairs two node pointers, one for the overlay fragment and one for the affected target subtree.
Each overlay lifecycle phase has a short human label in table order matching the phase enumeration: init, pre-apply, post-apply, pre-remove, post-remove.
The disabled overlay path reports not supported for flat tree apply, single removal and remove all, while overlay notifier register and unregister report success without action.

Table declaration helpers associate a compatibility string and callback with a per table linker section, aligned and marked used, while the stub form keeps a local unused entry. Typed wrappers cover one node void handlers, one node integer returning handlers, and two node integer returning handlers.

The PCI range parser retains its node, bus description, current and end pointers into the range cells, address and size cell counts, parent address cell count, and a DMA flag. A parsed range exposes a bus address unioned with PCI address, CPU and parent bus addresses, size and flags. Generic range names alias the PCI forms.
Range iteration repeatedly requests the next parsed range from the parser until no further range object is returned, with a generic alias for the PCI iteration form.
Range counting returns zero for missing parser, node, range data or empty window, otherwise divides the pointer span by the sum of address, parent address and size cell counts.

Disabled address translation and mapping helpers report unavailability: mapping returns an error pointer, translation returns a bad address sentinel, address lookup returns null, register read and range parser setup and resource conversions report not supported, and DMA coherence reports false.

Address helpers map a resource lookup failure to invalid argument and mapping to null. Plain and PCI address getters delegate to a shared getter with a wildcard bar or index, and address counting increments while resource translation succeeds.
Disabled clock helpers report zero parent clocks, null parent name and perform no initialization action.

Device matching has an enabled form that succeeds exactly when the driver match table finds the device and a disabled form that always reports mismatch and null match. Modalias helpers report missing device, uevent and bus identifier helpers do nothing, and DMA configuration either delegates with a null identifier or reports success.
The flat device tree header marker has value 0xd00dfeed.

Disabled early boot device tree helpers do nothing for usable memory range checks, reserved memory scan, self reservation and unflattening, report missing device for chosen stdout scan, and return null for machine name lookup.

The interrupt map parser retains its node, a window over map cells and a parent offset. An interrupt map item combines parent phandle arguments with a count and fixed capacity array for child map cells sized to avoid allocation. The init callback takes two nodes and returns an integer.
Interrupt map iteration repeatedly requests the next item from the parser until none is returned.
Interrupt map option flags use bit zero for oldworld MAC handling and bit one for missing phandle handling. Workarounds are zero and the default interrupt parent is null in this configuration.
Reconfiguration change codes are zero for no change, one for add and two for remove.
Overlay notification phases are numbered zero through four in init, pre apply, post apply, pre remove, post remove order.

Disabled interrupt and MSI helpers do nothing for controller init and MSI configuration, report invalid argument for single and oldworld parsing, zero for counts, mappings and resource table fill, null for affinity, parent, map parser results and MSI domains, unsupported for map parser setup, and identity translation for MSI identifiers.

Overlay action naming indexes a fixed label table by caller supplied phase without a visible bounds check. Range counting divides by the sum of cell counts without showing protection against a zero total. Signed 32 bit helpers reinterpret unsigned output storage.
Each routed header defines its own include guard symbol so repeated inclusion is suppressed for address, clock, device, flattened tree, interrupt and PCI interrupt helpers.
